purpose: Teach: キャサリン/永田町/シェリー/ビクター/ディーン/クラッチ/ハンス/マルタ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキャサリン妃の伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father bought a biography of Princess Catherine.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gently sharing something noteworthy about what dad has done. Light, unbothered delivery — the kind of detail a mother mentions in passing to her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと永田町のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me about Nagatacho.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share his own experience. Quick tempo, genuine excitement in the voice. Still a child's straightforward joy — not performing, just delighted to report back.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシェリー酒を友人にプレゼントされたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father gave a bottle of sherry to a friend as a gift.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly wistful observation. Softer attack than the first line. Thoughtful pace — noticing and sharing something refined about her husband's taste and generosity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとビクターのレコード聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad played a Victor record for me.
lines.style: Same eager brightness as before. Direct eye contact in the voice. Immediate, childlike pride in being included in something grown-up and special with Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェームス・ディーンの映画祭に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father went to a James Dean film festival.
lines.style: Composed, slightly admiring tone. A beat longer between phrases than her first two lines — she's thinking as she speaks. Warm but with a thread of quiet wonder at her husband's interests.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと車のクラッチ操作見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Dad work the clutch in the car.
lines.style: High, clear voice. Breathless with the importance of the detail. Rapid delivery — he's bursting to say this, to report on something mechanical and grown-up he got to witness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハンス童話の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father lent you a Hans Andersen storybook.
lines.style: Softer opening than the previous reflective lines. Quieter overall — almost tender in the delivery. She's noticing the kindness in the lending, not just the fact of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマルタ島旅行のお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I talked about our trip to Malta.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied close. Slower than his eager reports, tinged with the contentment of a memory shared and held. Voice settles — he's happy to have had this moment with Dad.
